data.one_liner: Detects API response parsing errors and sends reports to Discord webhooks.
data.what_it_does: Intercepts Dio and HTTP client requests to automatically catch JSON parsing issues, type mismatches, and missing keys. It logs these errors locally and forwards them to a Discord webhook with retry support.
use_when: You want to automatically track API data-mismatch and parsing errors in production
You use Dio or the http package and want quick Discord alerts for malformed backend responses
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions
You do not use Discord for error logging or webhook alerts
strengths: Built-in integrations for both Dio and the http package
Automatic type mismatch and missing key detection
Supports local file logging and automatic webhook retry queues
weaknesses: Limited to Discord webhook integration out of the box
Relies on heuristics and exception analysis which might miss edge-case errors
data.setup_notes: Requires a Discord webhook URL and initialization of the ApiErrorMonitor instance or package interceptors.
